about: Recordings for the composer's call of the recorded-model double (T-1071, C-123). Each is one plan answer keyed by the sha256 of its canonical composer input (K-03 v1: $defs/composeInput in, $defs/plan out). They are seeded from K-03 v1's plan fixtures (contracts/message-plan/fixtures), not recorded live: no model call is made (J-02a). The s1-02 pair is K-03's own (input-s1-02, plan-s1-02). K-03 has no input for its other five plans, so each has a small synthetic input in ai/recordings/composer-inputs, written from the master's sample cast (Sam, Lee's Barbershop, Alex M., Riley, Ben T., the 5160 code, 88 Elm St) and fixture set v1's therapist demo shop (Lee Associates, Maya); no real person or customer appears (rule 9). Slot values in the inputs' facts are the slot examples of slots.json. The walking skeleton's JOIN run (T-1145; contracts/model/README.md 'v1.1', recording 4) composes S1-02's question from input-s1-02.json for that run's own row and turn (round 2, DL-347: the turn id T-248's hash of the JOIN's event id evt-sam-0000, the row outbox-s1-02-<that turn id>-1 by ADR-013 default 131), replying to the text JOIN at its time as tests/e2e/skeleton sends it (composer-inputs/join-s1-02.json; the double's test computes each id by its rule), and gets plan-s1-02.json's plan.
